connector.name: Krystal Voice Caller
connector.registryDescription: Drive a Krystal Voice Caller tenant from Claude, Cursor, or any MCP-aware agent.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package kvc-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the krystalunity account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: KVC_API_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token starting with kvc_token_. Generate at https://krystalunity.com/voice/krystal-caller/dashboard/api-tokens
